title: Time Limit
paragraphs: “Out of the way! Do you even understand what you’re trying to do!?”
“Yeah, we know. We all received the call in our dreams, all of us reincarnated from another world. From the goddess, that is.”
“Why would you trust someone who merely claims to be a god!?”
“Naofumi, these guys are reincarnators! Remember the previous cases.”
“Yeah, I never intended to listen to them from the start!”
“They begged us, saying, ‘If we don’t release the wave quickly, the world will be destroyed! Please lend us your strength!’ But you’re the ones trying to destroy the world!”
“Don’t be ridiculous! Why would someone with that kind of power rely on you guys? Sorry to say, but you’re just being used!”
Ugh… the time is ticking down fast.
There’s no other choice now!
“Ren, Itsuki, let’s do this!”
“Yeah!”
“Understood!”
“Father should stay in the rear and provide support magic. The queen will unleash her strongest magic at the front!”
“Of course!”
We took a brief moment to gather ourselves and then unleashed our skills.
“Brionac X!”
“Meteor Sword X!”
“Full Buster X!”

With my Brionac, I shattered the regenerated barrier, and Ren and Itsuki’s attacks reduced the enemy to ashes. To finish them off, the queen summoned rain clouds from the sky and brought down lightning.
“Judgment X!”
“Bubuuu!?”
The remaining enemies were wiped out!
“All that’s left is to attack the fissure!”
I raised my spear and unleashed my Meteor Spear.
“Meteor Spear X!”
However, it was blocked with a loud clang once again.
“Are there too many people with barrier abilities!? And now they’re staying inside the fissure, not even coming out!”
“There’s no choice! We have to destroy it with every skill we’ve got! There’s no time to wait for cooldowns!”
“Agreed! Air Strike Bash X! Second Bash X! Triad Bash X!”
“Multi Thrust X! Air Strike Javelin X! Second Javelin X! Triad Javelin X!”
“Air Strike Arrow X! Second Arrow X! Triad Arrow X! Ugh… just a little more!”
We kept unleashing our attack skills one after another. Each time, the barrier was shattered, but now the fissure itself started glowing red.
“What… what’s happening!?”
“Heh… did you think it only reduced the remaining time? I’ve also fortified the fissure itself!”
What an incredibly irritating line! These guys have been annoying from the start!
“The victory is already ours. No matter how powerful your attacks are, the fissure won’t close for at least 30 seconds!”
There’s no longer a barrier. We’re all focusing our attacks on the fissure, but it’s showing no signs of closing.
“Let’s take down the caster!”
“Yeah!”
“Understood!”
As we tried to enter the fissure, our weapons were repelled. —**Interdimensional travel by the Four Cardinal Heroes is forbidden.** The words appeared in my vision.
“Damn it! We can only attack from here!?”
“Our attacks can’t reach through the fissure!?”
“Is there no way!? Motoyasu-kun, Ren, Itsuki!”
Father feels frustrated, unable to do anything but defend.
“My sister and the others will go!”
“Yeah! We need to get a little payback!”
“Sadina! Larsa!”
“Let’s go!”
“Let’s gooo!”
Yuki-chan and the filolials charged forward! Of course, Sakura-chan and Kou were with them.
“I’m going too!”
Led by Éclair, the soldiers raised their voices and followed.
“Then I’ll cast support magic on everyone! All Liberation Aura X!”
Father cast support magic on everyone.
“Damn it! These guys just won’t give up!”
The enemies beyond the fissure groaned bitterly.
“Imia-chan. Let’s go too! Come on, Gaelion!”
“Gaelion wants to loop na no—oo!”

This dragon keeps saying the same thing over and over! But he’s showing his enthusiasm! He’s attacking with power I’ve never seen before. The mole isn’t backing down either, charging in and using its small sword to stab the reincarnators through their openings. Even those who aren’t heroes are joining forces and charging toward the fissure where the enemies are. But the time is running out.
Ugh…
Is there really nothing I can do!? Will it end up the same as that time?
I will absolutely stop it this time!
“Father! I’ll pour all my strength into this and break through! Order everyone to fall back!”
“Understood! Sadina-san! Everyone! Hurry back!”
Father shouted toward the open fissure. Even as he was pushed back, he reached out desperately.
I have to protect Yuki-chan and the others too!
“Understood!”

My sister’s sister gave orders to everyone beyond the fissure, and they started returning. In the meantime, I gathered as much energy boost as I could. My spear absorbed the energy boost and began to shine brilliantly.
“Motoyasu-kun, do your best!”
Father cast support magic on me.
“I won’t lose either.”
Itsuki cast debuffing support magic toward the fissure and the enemies beyond it.
“Brionac X!”

I unleashed Brionac with the greatest output I’ve ever mustered. The heat from releasing it was enough to make the spear burn and scorch me. The Brionac I unleashed hit the fissure of the wave. According to their logic, a fortified fissure shouldn’t be destroyed, but a grating sound echoed as it began to scrape away at it.
“Pointless.”
A smug and irritating voice echoed from beyond the fissure.
But I can’t give up here!
“Uooooooohhhhhhhh! Filo-taaan!!”
With a battle cry, I stepped forward with all my might, and in that moment, I felt a satisfying sound and sensation. The attack that had been blocked before… had pierced through the fissure.

The voices of those grinning beyond the fissure were abruptly cut off. Then, the fissure vanished, leaving behind only light and remnants. At first, it was glowing with a rumbling sound, but I could feel that my attack had pushed back whatever was approaching from the other side. Yes, it felt like I had used Brionac to push back a giant meteor that was about to collide with the earth and send it back into space.
“Did we… win?”

The countdown that had been displayed in my vision was gone. The forecast for the next wave’s arrival was displayed. It was really close, but we somehow made it in time. As expected of Filo-tan. Just calling out her name filled me with power.
“What were those guys just now?”
“They looked like reincarnators.”
“Yes. It seems that people like that exist even beyond the waves.”
“But it looked like Motoyasu’s high-output Brionac wiped them out.”
“Yeah.”
“They were troublesome opponents, but if they’re defeated, it should be fine now.”
“We did it!”
I let out a victorious shout. And I heard cheers from the filolials.
“Come to think of it… this situation reminds me of something from the first world.”
“Really?”
“Why didn’t you say so earlier?”
“I couldn’t remember, I say. Most of my memories around this time are hazy.”
“So it’s not that you didn’t say it because no one asked?”
I nodded in response to Itsuki’s words.
“What happened in the first world?”
“If I remember correctly, we couldn’t suppress it back then. After that… I can’t recall.”
“So… back then, Motoyasu-kun died… and the world was destroyed?”
“That might be the case.”
But why? Something feels different.
Was that strike that pierced my chest really because the world was destroyed…?
“It’s true that if they were that powerful, we might have lost.”
“Actually, we almost did lose.”
“Yeah. Maybe we were too optimistic. We’ll need to train harder than ever.”
“Agreed.”
“Anyway, today was a lot, but let’s celebrate our victory and prepare for the next wave.”
“Understood, sir!”
As I reveled in victory after surviving the timeline of the first world, I was in the middle of starting the cleanup process.
“Huh?”

—My vision turned gray, and the world froze. And then, the icon that appears when the loop starts surfaced. This time, neither the sword, spear, bow, nor shield was glowing. However, one section of the icon was glowing.
“W-What’s going on here?”
Soon, my spear began trembling, and an analog clock appeared in my vision, with the minute hand winding backward. Something is wrong. Father, Ren, and Itsuki are all alive.
What’s causing this?
I can’t identify it!
No… wait. I remember the pain in my chest from the first time I looped.
Could this be… the moment when I died? Does that mean there’s some kind of time limit?
“W-What’s happening!?”
“What is this!?”
In that gray world, I heard a voice and turned my gaze in that direction. There, I saw my rival standing silently, half-transparent.
“Why can you move!?”
My rival responded with an unusually gloomy expression.
“Gaelion created memory space in the Spear Hero’s spear, so I can move.”
“Guh…”
What he mentioned before… it turns out to be true.
I can’t believe my spear was really cursed… Damn it!
“Why is this looping!?”
“Oh? Didn’t you want to loop?”
“Gaelion wanted to loop… but I never imagined it would end like this…”
My rival looks surprisingly dejected. He’s nothing like the annoying dragon who kept whining about looping.
“Gaelion… Gaelion wanted to loop, but this isn’t how it was supposed to end!”
“What a strange creature. This is what looping is.”

I know this because I’ve been through it so many times. Father said it last time. Even if this world ends, it’s connected to the next one. And in this loop, I’ve made many promises. Not just to Father. To Ren, Itsuki, and many others. I’ll carry those promises to the next world.
“I know that! But Gaelion doesn’t want it to end like this!”
“I don’t understand. What’s your problem?”
“Gaelion wants to loop so he can be the first for Naofumi. That hasn’t changed. But Gaelion also wants Naofumi and everyone to be happy! Gaelion wanted to see that!”
“Won’t you jump to a parallel world?”
“No! This doesn’t feel like that! Gaelion is a dragon emperor, so I can sense it when the spear activates!”
Hmm… I see. It’s irritating, but guiding Father and the others toward a happy future is my mission in these loops. In that sense, I can somewhat understand what this creature is saying.
However… this might be proof of what Father said last time, that everything will be undone. Well, it’s coming from my rival, so it’s hardly worth believing.
“Has the Spear Hero been repeating this for a long time?”
“Yes, that’s right.”
My rival looks at me with an oddly sympathetic gaze. What’s this? Stop it, or I’ll stab you.
“Does the Spear Hero not want to escape this loop?”
“I will keep moving forward until I meet Filo-tan.”
“You idiot! There’s a complete idiot standing right here!”
Shut up. My love won’t be stopped by something like this. And no matter how many loops it takes, I will save Father.
“Gaelion can’t bring his body along in the loop like the Spear Hero.”
“You mentioned that before.”
“If Gaelion were fully manifested, he could explain better. So hurry and make him real.”
“I refuse.”
“Nano! Nano! Why not!?”
“Because I don’t want to.”
“Gaelion hates this kind of ending! End the loop! Gaelion hates the Spear Hero, but he’ll help for Naofumi and everyone’s sake, so please—”

With those words, it seems I’m being pulled back to the moment I was summoned. It looks like my arguments with my rival will end here. I will definitely crush his ambitions. Now then… I had no intention of giving up, but this time, I will fulfill Father’s wishes and meet Filo-tan.
